snow-canvas.$description: Snow Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, nav surface — the dominant neutral that makes blue accents feel switched on

lavender-wash.$description: Lavender Wash — Subtle accent surface behind hero and feature blocks — gives cool-tinted depth without darkening the page

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Hero and section headings — near-black with a violet cast, reads warmer than pure black against white

graphite-body.$description: Graphite Body — Body text, secondary headings, product UI labels — workhorse dark neutral with cool undertone

slate-caption.$description: Slate Caption — Muted body text, nav labels, list items — medium-dark gray for subordinate copy

ash-helper.$description: Ash Helper — Helper text, metadata, timestamps — lighter gray for tertiary information

stone-divider.$description: Stone Divider — Hairline borders, card edges, divider lines — barely-there separation between surfaces

fog-surface.$description: Fog Surface — Input backgrounds, disabled states, subtle grouping surfaces — one shade darker than canvas

royal-signal.$description: Royal Signal — Primary brand accent — headlines, links, hero word highlight, pipeline-active dots, logo mark. Single saturated hue carries the entire brand identity

cobalt-glow.$description: Cobalt Glow — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

mint-win.$description: Mint Win — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

coral-lost.$description: Coral Lost — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

amber-pending.$description: Amber Pending — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

azure-focus.$description: Azure Focus — Input focus ring glow — pure blue that distinguishes active form state from ambient blue brand color

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter.$description: Primary typeface for headings, body, nav, buttons — the only text family on the page. Weights split: 600 for hero/section headlines, 500 for subheadings and nav, 400 for body copy. Display sizes (56–80px) use aggressive negative tracking (-0.027 to -0.037em) that compresses letterforms into a tight confident block.

pretendard.$description: Secondary typeface used for Korean-language rendering and specific UI labels with positive tracking (+0.019 to +0.030em) — appears in localized product UI strings

roboto-mono.$description: Monospace accent for code-adjacent text, numerical callouts, and technical labels — negative tracking makes it feel geometric

font-awesome-6-pro-light.$description: Font Awesome 6 Pro Light — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

font-awesome-6-pro-solid.$description: Font Awesome 6 Pro Solid — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

font-awesome-6-pro-regular.$description: Font Awesome 6 Pro Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

font-awesome-6-brands-regular.$description: Font Awesome 6 Brands Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
